meaning.en: In a consequential manner; with consequence or significance.
meaning.vi: Theo cách thức kết quả; với hệ quả hoặc ý nghĩa.

sentences.en: The achievements of University Science Park will consequentially accelerate both the startup and operation of Knowledge Economy.

sentences.en: Whoever drinks the poison will die consequentially, which is the unvarying truth.

sentences.en: Since signals must be transmitted in noise channel, it will produce many inaccurate code consequentially. Adoption of error-correcting technique can assure accuracy and reliability of data.
